subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should a workflow/security owner approve the `openai/codex-action` v1.11 upgrade after reviewing its exact source contract for the OpenAI-key-bearing performance workflow, or should that action be held back from this grouped Dependabot update?
rationale: The diff changes a third-party executable action at a secrets boundary, and repository policy requires a direct Codex source inspection before a Codex-related approval; that trust decision cannot be inferred from the Dependabot manifest or ordinary checks.

options.title: Review and approve the grouped update
options.body: Verify the exact Codex action revision and the elevated-permission action contracts, then allow the complete SHA-pinned update if the reviewed workflow run is clean.

options.title: Split out the Codex action bump
options.body: Land the non-Codex action updates separately and hold `openai/codex-action` at its current pinned revision until its contract review is complete.

recommendation.title: Review and approve the grouped update
recommendation.body: Verify the exact Codex action revision and the elevated-permission action contracts, then allow the complete SHA-pinned update if the reviewed workflow run is clean.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete current-main workflow owner could not be identified because repository history inspection was unavailable.
